blockers.fix: Add protagonist and antagonist with visual anchors.
Break the beat sheet into panels.
Describe the setting and the frozen moment.
Move the balloon inside the safe area.
Write the line or delete the balloon.

blockers.check: estimated balloon bounding boxes do not intersect
blockers.fix: Run the auto-layouter: reading order top-to-bottom, no overlaps, inside the safe area. Auto-repairable.

blockers.check: size matches text length vs kind ceiling (sm <35%, md 35-75%, lg >75%)
blockers.fix: Let the engine pick the type size. Auto-repairable.

blockers.check: SFX boxes do not cover balloon boxes or panel centre
blockers.fix: Nudge the SFX to open art. Auto-repaired with the layouter.
End on a physical event that costs the protagonist.
Re-link the panel to a real character.
Re-draw or re-write to match the ledger.

blockers.check: panel.versions ids exist in project.versions and belong to the bound character
blockers.fix: Re-pick the version in Panel Director, or clear the binding.
Move wardrobe into outfit; a costume change must never be able to redesign the face.
Split the episode, or widen the canvas so panels cover more vertical distance.

notes.fix: Split into another panel or cut a line.
Halve the line; let the art carry the rest.
Shorten or split the balloon.

notes.check: no 3+ silent panels in a row
notes.fix: Add a caption, SFX, or a reaction shot.
Stretch establishing/splash; compress reactions.
Move dialogue to the next panel.
Mark the signature beat as full bleed.

notes.check: speech balloons have tails in multi-character panels
notes.fix: Add a tail pointing at the mouth.
Auto-layouter restacks in reading order.

notes.check: gap between any two balloon boxes >= 4% of panel; edge clearance >= 2%
notes.fix: Space engine (lettering engine) enforces MIN_BUBBLE_GAP=4, MIN_EDGE_GAP=2. Auto-repairable via balloon-spacing.

notes.check: one size per balloon kind, matched to line length
notes.fix: Engine auto-sizes sm/md/lg from fill ratio.

notes.check: SFX never covers a balloon or the panel centre
notes.fix: Nudge to open art.

notes.check: no identical shot twice in a row
notes.fix: Change angle or shot to argue something.
Use 200px before scroll turns.
Write a 35-55 word visual anchor.
Derive the lock from the chosen look.

notes.check: every recurring character owns a portrait or full-body sheet
notes.fix: Bible → Reference memory: generate or attach portrait + full body before rendering.

notes.check: every version bound to a panel owns a required sheet
notes.fix: Generate the sheets for that version, or unbind and keep the base design.
List the details that must survive the change — that is what makes it a transformation, not a recast.

notes.check: panels in the same scene reuse one location string
notes.fix: Pick the canonical location from the world list; identical wording keeps the place the same place.

notes.check: image provider supports reference images when refs are attached
notes.fix: Use gpt-image or a Gemini image model, or accept text-only rendering knowingly.

notes.check: no section boundary lands in the middle 40% of a panel
notes.fix: Add 60-120px to the gutter above that panel so the cut lands in empty space.
Render at or above the canvas width; upscaling softens lineart first.
Re-light the panel or push the blacks; flat panels read as fog on a phone.
Crop the border or re-render full-bleed; bars become visible seams in the scroll.

readability: Nothing critical within 20px of an edge
continuity: Time of day and weather consistent
Same key light direction per scene
Knowledge: who knows what, and when
platformReview: Dimensions and file size within spec
No copyrighted characters or living-artist style names
accessibility: No strobe sequences longer than three panels
Text summary per episode for screen readers
